=== FILE: PROJECT.md ===
# SCIVO — PROJECT PASSPORT (v1.1)

## Decisions (approved by PO)
- Test format: Web link (PWA) via GitHub Pages: https://radikmardanov.github.io/scivo/
- Audience: families in Russia, children 7–10 (grades 1–4)
- Accounts: family model. Only parent has email/password (Supabase Auth).
  Children = rows in `children` (nickname, avatar, grade, 4-digit PIN hashed on server).
  Parent zone: parental gate (math task) + parent PIN (server-verified).
- AI: no LLM in v1. Rule-based "Scivo Brain" (error diagnostics + 3-level hints + phrase bank in DB). LLM-ready JSON contract for v2.
- Voice: flutter_tts (all Scivo lines), speech_to_text for answers, keypad fallback.
- Graphics: SVG by Illustrator role (lib/art), animations in Flutter.
- Notifications: in-app + email via Yandex SMTP (stage 5).
- Data minimization: parent email; child nickname, avatar, grade. Parent consent stored (parents.consent_at).
- Worlds v1: Forest of Counting, Bridge of Numbers, Cave of Multiplication, Clock Tower, Fractions of Chaos.
- Mechanics: keypad, voice, drag&drop, drawing/shading, puzzle, clock rotation, choice, boss battle.
- Answers and rewards: server-side only (SQL RPC). Client never writes balances.
- Economy: Feathers (no-hint success, bosses, daily cap), Mana (activity, streak, fixed errors), wishlist with feather freeze.

## Delivery pipeline
- PO pastes text bundles into bundle/partN.txt on GitHub web.
- Workflow .github/workflows/build.yml unpacks bundles, commits files, builds Flutter Web, deploys to Pages.
- Bundles may NOT write into .github, .git or bundle folders.
- flutter create runs in CI; never name our tests widget_test.dart (CI deletes that file).
- Secrets: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in GitHub Actions secrets. Nothing secret in code or chat.

## Backend rules
- Migrations: supabase/migrations/NNN_name.sql, run by PO in SQL Editor.
- Column-level grants: client must select explicit columns (no select *) on parents/children.
- Day boundary for streaks: Europe/Moscow.

## Stages
0 Accounts & checks — DONE
1 DB & security (migration 001) — IN REVIEW
2 App skeleton + first link — IN PROGRESS (part1: pipeline check)
3 Quest engine + 5 worlds
4 Scivo Brain + voice
5 Parent dashboard, wishlist, email
6 QA & polish

=== FILE: lib/core/config/env_config.dart ===
class EnvConfig {
  const EnvConfig._();

  static const String supabaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment('SUPABASE_URL');
  static const String supabaseAnonKey =
      String.fromEnvironment('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY');

  static bool get isConfigured =>
      supabaseUrl.isNotEmpty && supabaseAnonKey.isNotEmpty;
}

=== FILE: lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:google_fonts/google_fonts.dart';

class AppColors {
  AppColors._();

  static const purple = Color(0xFF7248D8);
  static const purpleLight = Color(0xFF9B7BFF);
  static const gold = Color(0xFFFFD700);
  static const night = Color(0xFF1B1F4B);
  static const nightCard = Color(0xFF2A2F6B);
  static const success = Color(0xFF4ADE80);
  static const danger = Color(0xFFFF6B6B);

  static const nightGradient = LinearGradient(
    begin: Alignment.topCenter,
    end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
    colors: [Color(0xFF2E2177), night, Color(0xFF0F1230)],
  );
}

class AppTheme {
  AppTheme._();

  static ThemeData dark() {
    final base = ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      brightness: Brightness.dark,
      colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
        seedColor: AppColors.purple,
        brightness: Brightness.dark,
      ).copyWith(
        primary: AppColors.purple,
        secondary: AppColors.gold,
        surface: AppColors.nightCard,
      ),
    );

    final textTheme = GoogleFonts.quicksandTextTheme(base.textTheme).apply(
      bodyColor: Colors.white,
      displayColor: Colors.white,
    );

    return base.copyWith(
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: AppColors.night,
      textTheme: textTheme,
      filledButtonTheme: FilledButtonThemeData(
        style: FilledButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: AppColors.purple,
          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
          minimumSize: const Size(120, 56),
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 28, vertical: 14),
          textStyle: GoogleFonts.quicksand(
            fontSize: 20,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Векторный вороненок Scivo (роль: Иллюстратор). Версия 0.1.
/// Слои: tail, body, wing_left, wing_right, head, eyes, beak.
/// Слоты для косметики (шляпа, плащ) добавятся на этапе 3.
class RavenArt {
  RavenArt._();

  static const String _template = r'''
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200">
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="192" rx="46" ry="6" fill="#000000" fill-opacity="0.25"/>
  <path d="M84 168 L100 196 L116 168 Z" fill="#1E2147"/>
  <path d="M86 176 L80 190 M86 176 L90 190" stroke="#FFB020" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M114 176 L110 190 M114 176 L120 190" stroke="#FFB020" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="128" rx="54" ry="56" fill="#2B2E5C"/>
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="140" rx="32" ry="36" fill="#454A8F"/>
  <path d="M50 112 Q26 142 52 170 Q70 152 70 122 Z" fill="#1E2147"/>
  <path d="M150 112 Q174 142 148 170 Q130 152 130 122 Z" fill="#1E2147"/>
  <circle cx="100" cy="72" r="44" fill="#2B2E5C"/>
  <path d="M100 30 Q90 12 102 2 Q114 16 100 30 Z" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <path d="M100 30 L101 12" stroke="#E0A800" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="88" r="7" fill="#FF8FB1" fill-opacity="0.55"/>
  <circle cx="128" cy="88" r="7" fill="#FF8FB1" fill-opacity="0.55"/>
  %%EYES%%
  <path d="M71 50 Q83 46 95 51" stroke="#12142E" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M105 48 Q117 40 129 47" stroke="#12142E" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M90 84 L110 84 L100 100 Z" fill="#FFB020"/>
  <path d="M90 84 L110 84 L100 90 Z" fill="#FFCC4D"/>
</svg>
''';

  static const String _eyesOpen = '''
  <circle cx="84" cy="68" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="116" cy="68" r="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="70" r="7" fill="#12142E"/>
  <circle cx="118" cy="70" r="7" fill="#12142E"/>
  <circle cx="88.5" cy="67" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="120.5" cy="67" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
''';

  static const String _eyesClosed = '''
  <path d="M72 70 Q84 78 96 70" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M104 70 Q116 78 128 70" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
''';

  static final String idle = _template.replaceAll('%%EYES%%', _eyesOpen);
  static final String blink = _template.replaceAll('%%EYES%%', _eyesClosed);
}

=== FILE: lib/widgets/scivo_raven.dart ===
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_svg/flutter_svg.dart';

import '../art/raven_art.dart';

/// Анимированный Scivo: мягко парит и моргает.
class ScivoRaven extends StatefulWidget {
  const ScivoRaven({super.key, this.size = 160});

  final double size;

  @override
  State<ScivoRaven> createState() => _ScivoRavenState();
}

class _ScivoRavenState extends State<ScivoRaven>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _bob = AnimationController(
    vsync: this,
    duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1600),
  )..repeat(reverse: true);

  Timer? _blinkTimer;
  bool _eyesClosed = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _scheduleBlink();
  }

  void _scheduleBlink() {
    _blinkTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 3200), () {
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _eyesClosed = true);
      _blinkTimer = Timer(const Duration(milliseconds: 160), () {
        if (!mounted) return;
        setState(() => _eyesClosed = false);
        _scheduleBlink();
      });
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _blinkTimer?.cancel();
    _bob.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedBuilder(
      animation: _bob,
      builder: (context, child) {
        final t = Curves.easeInOut.transform(_bob.value);
        return Transform.translate(offset: Offset(0, -8 * t), child: child);
      },
      child: SvgPicture.string(
        _eyesClosed ? RavenArt.blink : RavenArt.idle,
        width: widget.size,
        height: widget.size,
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: lib/main.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';

import 'core/config/env_config.dart';
import 'core/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'widgets/scivo_raven.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  String? initError;
  if (EnvConfig.isConfigured) {
    try {
      await Supabase.initialize(
        url: EnvConfig.supabaseUrl,
        anonKey: EnvConfig.supabaseAnonKey,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      initError = error.toString();
    }
  } else {
    initError = 'Не заданы SUPABASE_URL и SUPABASE_ANON_KEY';
  }

  runApp(ProviderScope(child: ScivoApp(initError: initError)));
}

class ScivoApp extends StatelessWidget {
  const ScivoApp({super.key, this.initError});

  final String? initError;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'Scivo',
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
      theme: AppTheme.dark(),
      home: MagicCheckScreen(initError: initError),
    );
  }
}

class MagicCheckScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const MagicCheckScreen({super.key, this.initError});

  final String? initError;

  @override
  State<MagicCheckScreen> createState() => _MagicCheckScreenState();
}

class _MagicCheckScreenState extends State<MagicCheckScreen> {
  late Future<String> _
